name: Marketplace Chat → CRM Draft → Approval → Reply

nodes.name: Every Minute
nodes.notes: Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop have no chat webhook worth relying on, so the inbox is polled. None of the three has a voice-call API at all, which is why this workflow only ever deals in text.

nodes.name: Chat Accounts
nodes.notes: Every connected Shopee, Lazada, TikTok and Meta account on every active floor. A suspended floor is not in the list.

nodes.name: One Account Each
nodes.notes: One item per account. A paused sync is skipped here rather than later, so a shop someone switched off is genuinely left alone.

nodes.name: Get Account Credentials
nodes.notes: Decrypted server-side and read only here. Every read is logged against the account, so a token that leaves the database leaves a trail.

nodes.name: Which Marketplace
nodes.notes: Meta DMs keep their own workflow (workflow_messenger_inbound.json); anything else falls through to the honest refusal.

nodes.name: Fetch Chat
nodes.notes: neverError, because a marketplace that is down must not take the whole sweep with it: the item carries on and the next account still runs.

nodes.name: Normalise Messages
nodes.notes: A message the seller sent is skipped on every platform, or the desk would answer itself in a loop.

nodes.name: File Inbound
nodes.notes: 423 means the floor is suspended — the run stops there for that account.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ business_id: $('Normalise Messages').item.json.business_id, department: "CRM", message: "Reading a buyer message" }) }}

nodes.name: Claim The CRM Desk
nodes.notes: 423 if the desk is paused or the floor is suspended, which aborts this message. PAUSED wins here exactly as it does everywhere else.

nodes.name: Read The Thread
nodes.notes: The last forty lines, so the draft answers what was actually asked rather than only the newest sentence.

nodes.name: Ask Ollama
nodes.notes: If Ollama is down this comes back without a response and the next node files nothing, leaving the desk to be released rather than filing an empty draft for someone to approve.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent_id: $('Build The Prompt').item.json.agent_id, payload: { type: "chat_reply", title: `Reply to ${$('Read The Thread').item.json.conversation.buyer_name}`, draft: ($json.response || "").trim(), channel: $('Read The Thread').item.json.conversation.channel, recipient: $('Read The Thread').item.json.conversation.buyer_handle, conversation_id: $('Build The Prompt').item.json.conversation_id, account_id: $('Read The Thread').item.json.conversation.account_id, source: { conversation_id: $('Build The Prompt').item.json.conversation_id } } }) }}

nodes.name: File The Draft
nodes.notes: PENDING. Nothing has reached the buyer; the desk now reads AWAITING_APPROVAL until a human clicks.

nodes.name: Release The Desk
nodes.notes: A desk claimed for a message the model could not answer goes back to IDLE rather than sitting at WORKING forever.

nodes.name: Approved Reply
nodes.notes: Called by the backend only after an approval row has moved PENDING -> APPROVED. Set N8N_CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL to this path.

nodes.name: Really Send
nodes.notes: Skipped for an item already marked failed; the next node reads either.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ approval_id: $('What Was Approved').item.json.approval_id, body: $('What Was Approved').item.json.text, failed: Boolean($json.failed) || ($json.statusCode ?? 200) >= 400, error: $json.error ?? null, external_id: $json.body?.message_id ?? null }) }}

nodes.name: Report What Happened
nodes.notes: The only place an outbound line is written, and it can only be written against an approval that is APPROVED. A failure puts the thread back to OPEN so it is visibly still unanswered.
